stateKeys.name: params
stateKeys.type: object, the OpenAccount command ({ accountId, bankId, clientEmail, address, bankDetails, failAt }); {} before START

stateKeys.name: failedStep
stateKeys.type: enum: '' | 'createAccount' | 'addAddress' | 'addClient' | 'addBankAccount', the forward step that failed ('' if none)

stateKeys.name: reason
stateKeys.type: string, why the run ended without opening ('' otherwise)

dataFields.failAt: enum: '' | 'createAccount' | 'addAddress' | 'addClient' | 'addBankAccount', the sample's failure injection (shouldThrow on that step's command)

specialRules.name: stale-completions-reject
specialRules.note: A completion arriving in any state other than the one that awaits it is an observable rejection (post == pre), never a fault.

specialRules.name: compensate-lifo
specialRules.note: A forward step's failure compensates the steps that succeeded before it, last first: a client failure clears the address; a bank failure removes the client, then clears the address. An account or address failure has nothing to compensate.

specialRules.name: stop-or-cancel
specialRules.note: STOP ends a run that has nothing to undo (idle, creating the account, adding the address: those steps register no compensation upstream either). Once a step succeeded, a person CANCELs instead: the run compensates what succeeded, last first, and ends compensated with reason 'cancelled'.

noOpRule: An action that does not apply in the current state is reject(reason) - an observable no-op with post == pre.
